question: What Synology attachment payload, retrieval, and staging policy should the bundled Synology Chat plugin support for inbound images, CSV files, and PDFs?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but accepting attachments changes the plugin's network and file-ingestion boundary, so automation should not choose the external contract or safety policy alone.

options.title: Confirm contract and safe staging
options.body: Require a real Synology attachment payload/API contract, then implement plugin-local bounded retrieval with MIME, size, lifetime, cleanup, and SSRF tests before enabling the feature.

options.title: Wait for reporter payload proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a user supplies redacted NAS webhook payloads and retrieval details, avoiding speculative API support.

options.title: Decline bundled inbound attachments
options.body: Leave inbound attachments unsupported in the bundled plugin unless maintainers decide this channel warrants the security review cost.

recommendation.title: Confirm contract and safe staging
recommendation.body: Require a real Synology attachment payload/API contract, then implement plugin-local bounded retrieval with MIME, size, lifetime, cleanup, and SSRF tests before enabling the feature.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Synology Chat review comments, handler/docs refactors, and security-boundary work make this the best available routing candidate.
